Summary ⤵️
Every Claude Code command — ranked, explained, and sorted into tiers so you actually know which ones to use.

Most people type / and pick the first thing they see. This video covers every single command from login to stickers, split into 10 tiers from beginner essentials to power user and rarely-touched. By the end you'll know exactly what to use and when.
